exercises.name: Modified Side Plank with Band Row

Quad Sets.setup: Sit or lie with left leg extended. Roll a small towel under left knee for comfort.
Quad Sets.execution: Press back of left knee firmly into the surface. Hold 5 seconds, release completely. Repeat 10×.
Quad Sets.nwbCues: Pure isometric — zero joint movement, zero fracture stress. Can be done anywhere seated.

Short Arc Quads.setup: Sit with a rolled towel or foam roller under left knee creating ~30° of bend.
Short Arc Quads.execution: Slowly straighten left knee from 30° to full extension. Hold 1s at top, lower over 3 seconds.
Short Arc Quads.nwbCues: Last 30° of extension only — minimal hip involvement, pure quad activation.

Ankle Pumps & Circles.setup: Sit or lie comfortably with left leg supported or slightly elevated.
Ankle Pumps & Circles.execution: Slowly point and flex left foot (pumps), then circle ankle clockwise then counter-clockwise.
Ankle Pumps & Circles.nwbCues: Zero load on fracture site. Maintains ankle ROM and promotes circulation.

Banded Terminal Knee Extensions.setup: Sit with resistance band looped behind left knee and anchored at low height ahead of you.
Banded Terminal Knee Extensions.execution: Starting with knee slightly bent, extend against band resistance. Squeeze quad at full extension, lower slowly.
Banded Terminal Knee Extensions.nwbCues: Pure knee extension — zero hip flexion demand. Band provides gentle progressive resistance.

Reclined Knee Extensions.setup: Sit reclined with left leg supported at ~45° of bend. No added weight.
Reclined Knee Extensions.execution: Slowly extend left knee to full extension. Hold 1s at top, lower over 3 seconds.
Reclined Knee Extensions.nwbCues: Bodyweight only. Zero hip flexion. Keep range within the last 45° of knee extension.

Seated Cable Crunch.setup: Rope on high cable. Sit on a bench facing the stack, left leg hanging off the side. Hold rope ends at temples.
Seated Cable Crunch.execution: Flex spine forward, pulling elbows toward knees. Contract abs hard at bottom. Return with control.
Seated Cable Crunch.nwbCues: Hang left leg off the bench — keeps hip angle open and avoids >90° flexion on the fracture side. Do not crunch past the point where you feel the left hip loading.

Modified Hollow Body Hold.setup: Lie flat on mat. Right leg straight, left leg extended passively on the floor.
Modified Hollow Body Hold.execution: Press lower back into mat firmly. Lift right leg ~6 inches. Hold and breathe steadily.
Modified Hollow Body Hold.nwbCues: Left leg stays on the floor the entire time. No bilateral leg raise.

Pallof Press with Overhead Reach.setup: Seated sideways to a cable or band anchored at chest height. Hold handle at chest with both hands.
Pallof Press with Overhead Reach.execution: Press handle straight out, then reach overhead with arms extended. Return to chest. Resist rotation throughout.
Pallof Press with Overhead Reach.nwbCues: Seated only. Move deliberately — the overhead reach increases anti-rotation demand.

Modified Side Plank Hip Dips.setup: Side-lying on right forearm. Left leg rests passively on right leg. Lift right hip into modified side plank.
Modified Side Plank Hip Dips.execution: Lower right hip toward floor then lift back up. Full controlled range.
Modified Side Plank Hip Dips.nwbCues: Left leg is a passive rider. Core controls the dip — not hip momentum.

Modified Plank.setup: Forearm plank with both knees on the floor. Left knee passive, right knee bearing weight.
Modified Plank.execution: Hold position with core braced, hips level. Don't let hips sag or bridge up.
Modified Plank.nwbCues: Knee-supported version only — no full plank. Left leg contributes no force.

Reverse Crunch (R Leg Only).setup: Lie on mat. Left leg flat on floor (passive). Right leg bent at 90°, foot off floor.
Reverse Crunch (R Leg Only).execution: Using abs, curl pelvis up — lift tailbone off mat. Lower with control. No hip flexor momentum.
Reverse Crunch (R Leg Only).nwbCues: Left leg stays flat and passive throughout. Right leg is the only one assisting.

Single-Arm Seated Cable Row.setup: Sit at low cable row with single D-handle. Sit upright with slight forward lean, feet on platform.
Single-Arm Seated Cable Row.execution: Row handle to side of torso with controlled rotation. Full stretch at start, elbow past body at finish.
Single-Arm Seated Cable Row.nwbCues: Seated throughout, hips stable. Left foot rests on platform — no weight bearing.

Seated Oblique Cable Crunch.setup: Sit sideways on a bench next to high cable. Hold rope or D-handle at opposite ear with both hands.
Seated Oblique Cable Crunch.execution: Crunch sideways toward cable side. Obliques on far side stretch then contract. Return with control.
Seated Oblique Cable Crunch.nwbCues: Seated. Keep hips stable — only torso flexes laterally. Left leg passive.

Weighted Crunch (Seated).setup: Sit on a bench, left leg hanging off the side. Hold a plate or dumbbell at chest.
Weighted Crunch (Seated).execution: Flex spine forward — shoulders curl toward hips. Squeeze at top, lower slowly.
Weighted Crunch (Seated).nwbCues: Hang left leg off the bench to keep hip angle open on the fracture side. Don't crunch past the point of left hip loading. Use a support rail if balance is uncertain.

Modified Hollow Body Flutter.setup: Lie on mat. Left leg extended on floor (passive). Lower back pressed firmly to mat.
Modified Hollow Body Flutter.execution: Flutter kick with right leg only — small rapid up-down movements. Maintain hollow position.
Modified Hollow Body Flutter.nwbCues: Left leg stays on the floor. Do not bridge. Lower back contact is mandatory.

Seated Landmine Rotation.setup: Sit straddling a bench end. Hold loaded landmine bar end with both hands extended.
Seated Landmine Rotation.execution: Rotate torso side-to-side, controlling the arc of the bar. Hips stay square.
Seated Landmine Rotation.nwbCues: Hips face forward — only the torso rotates. Seated throughout.

Modified Side Plank with Band Row.setup: Modified side plank on knee and forearm. Resistance band anchored at low height ahead. Free hand holds band.
Modified Side Plank with Band Row.execution: Hold the side plank while rowing band to ribcage with free hand. Don't rotate.
Modified Side Plank with Band Row.nwbCues: Left knee is passive support. Hip flexion stays below 90°.

Modified Plank Shoulder Taps.setup: Knee-supported plank (both knees on floor). Core braced, hips level.
Modified Plank Shoulder Taps.execution: Lift one hand and tap opposite shoulder. Alternate sides without rotating hips.
Modified Plank Shoulder Taps.nwbCues: Knees on floor only — no full plank. Brace hard before each tap to prevent rotation.

Slow Dead Bugs (Modified).setup: Lie on mat. Arms pointing to ceiling. Right knee bent at 90° (foot off floor). Left leg extended on floor.
Slow Dead Bugs (Modified).execution: Slowly lower right arm overhead while keeping right knee bent. Press lower back to mat. Return.
Slow Dead Bugs (Modified).nwbCues: Left leg stays on floor — one-limb version only. Lower back contact is the non-negotiable cue.

High-to-Low Woodchop.setup: Seated at cable station. High cable with rope or D-handle. Sit tall with core braced.
High-to-Low Woodchop.execution: Pull cable diagonally from high-to-low across body, rotating torso. Control the eccentric return.
High-to-Low Woodchop.nwbCues: Seated only. Hip flexion minimal — rotation drives the movement.

Right Leg Lowers.setup: Lie on mat. Left leg extended on floor (passive). Right leg straight up toward ceiling.
Right Leg Lowers.execution: Slowly lower right leg toward floor, keeping lower back pressed down. Stop before back arches. Return slowly.
Right Leg Lowers.nwbCues: Left leg is passive and flat. Only right leg moves. Strict lower-back contact throughout.

Pallof Alphabet.setup: Seated sideways to cable or band. Hold handle at chest with both hands, arms extended.
Pallof Alphabet.execution: Trace letters A through J with the handle, keeping arms extended. Resist rotation throughout.
Pallof Alphabet.nwbCues: Seated. Small controlled movements. Core braced — the alphabet is the anti-rotation challenge.

Modified Side Plank Hold.setup: Side-lying on right forearm and right knee. Left knee stacked passively on right.
Modified Side Plank Hold.execution: Lift right hip off floor. Hold position with core braced. Breathe steadily.
Modified Side Plank Hold.nwbCues: Knee-supported version. Left leg is a passive rider — do not push off with it.

Low-to-High Woodchop.setup: Seated at cable station. Low cable with rope or D-handle. Sit tall.
Low-to-High Woodchop.execution: Pull cable diagonally from low-to-high across body, rotating torso. Follow movement with eyes. Control return.
Low-to-High Woodchop.nwbCues: Seated only. Hip flexion minimal — rotation drives movement.

Pallof ISO Hold.setup: Seated sideways to cable or band at chest height. Hold handle at chest with both hands.
Pallof ISO Hold.execution: Press handle straight out and HOLD. Resist any rotation. Breathe steadily through the hold.
Pallof ISO Hold.nwbCues: Seated. Start with lighter resistance to learn the anti-rotation demand.

Suitcase Hold (Seated).setup: Sit upright on a bench. Hold a dumbbell at your side (like a briefcase) in one hand.
Suitcase Hold (Seated).execution: Resist lateral lean — keep spine perfectly vertical while holding the weight. Switch sides.
Suitcase Hold (Seated).nwbCues: Seated. Core keeps you upright. No lateral hip shift.

Prone Y-Raise.setup: Lie face-down on prone ham curl machine. Ankles locked under pad. Arms hang down, thumbs up.
Prone Y-Raise.execution: Lift arms into Y overhead at ~45°. Squeeze lower traps hard at top for 2 seconds. Lower with control.
Prone Y-Raise.nwbCues: Ankles locked = zero lower-body demand. Pure scapular depression + retraction.

Prone T-Raise.setup: Lie face-down on prone ham curl machine. Ankles locked under pad. Arms hang down, palms down.
Prone T-Raise.execution: Raise arms straight out to sides. Pinch shoulder blades together at top. Hold 1-2 seconds.
Prone T-Raise.nwbCues: Ankles locked = zero lower-body demand. Mid-trap and rhomboid focus.

Prone W-Raise.setup: Lie face-down on prone ham curl machine. Ankles locked under pad. Elbows bent 90°.
Prone W-Raise.execution: Externally rotate shoulders, squeezing shoulder blades down and back into W shape. Hold 2 seconds.
Prone W-Raise.nwbCues: Ankles locked = zero lower-body demand. Rotator cuff prehab.

Prone Trunk Extension.setup: Lie face-down on prone ham curl machine. Ankles locked under pad. Hands behind head.
Prone Trunk Extension.execution: Lift chest 1-2 inches off pad. Hold 1 second at top. Lower with control. Add plate to progress.
Prone Trunk Extension.nwbCues: Ankles locked = zero lower-body demand. Anti-flexion core, fully NWB-safe.

Prone Iso Hold.setup: Lie face-down on prone ham curl machine. Ankles locked under pad. Arms at sides or behind head.
Prone Iso Hold.execution: Lift chest slightly off pad. Hold 20-45 seconds. Breathe into brace — don't hold breath.
Prone Iso Hold.nwbCues: Isometric erector hold. Ankles locked = zero lower-body demand. Respiratory demand is the progression.

Prone Lateral Trunk Raise.setup: Lie face-down on prone ham curl machine. Ankles locked under pad. Arms at sides.
Prone Lateral Trunk Raise.execution: Small side bend — lift and rotate torso slightly left, then right. Alternate sides. Keep range small.
Prone Lateral Trunk Raise.nwbCues: Ankles locked = zero lower-body demand. Controlled lateral flexion, thoracic spine only.

nearbySupersets.title: Left Ankle Dorsiflexion
nearbySupersets.instruction: Low cable, strap around top of left foot. Pull toes toward shin against cable resistance.
nearbySupersets.safety: Tibialis anterior maintenance for gait recovery. Fully seated or reclined.

nearbySupersets.title: Quad Sets (Bench)
nearbySupersets.instruction: Sit on nearby bench. Press back of left knee into bench surface. Hold 5 seconds, release, repeat.

nearbySupersets.title: Quad Sets (Bench)
nearbySupersets.instruction: Sit on nearby adjustable bench. Press back of left knee into bench surface. Hold 5 seconds, release, repeat.

nearbySupersets.title: Ankle Pumps & Circles
nearbySupersets.instruction: Lie or sit on mat. Point and flex left foot, then circle ankle in both directions.
nearbySupersets.safety: Zero load on fracture site. Maintains ankle ROM and promotes circulation.

nearbySupersets.title: Banded Terminal Knee Extensions
nearbySupersets.instruction: Sit with band looped behind left knee and anchored ahead. Extend left knee against band resistance.
nearbySupersets.safety: Pure knee extension — zero hip flexion demand. Band provides gentle progressive resistance.

nearbySupersets.title: Short Arc Quads
nearbySupersets.instruction: Sit on the dip machine seat. Place a rolled towel under left knee. Press knee down into towel, straighten last 30° of knee extension.
nearbySupersets.safety: Minimal range, pure quad activation. Zero hip flexor involvement.

nearbySupersets.title: TRX Left Knee Extension
nearbySupersets.instruction: Sit on the floor facing the TRX anchor. Place left foot in foot cradle. Extend left knee against the strap resistance — last 30° of extension only.
nearbySupersets.safety: Pure knee extension, zero hip flexion. TRX provides gentle accommodating resistance.

nearbySupersets.title: TRX Left Ankle Dorsiflexion
nearbySupersets.instruction: Sit with left foot in the TRX foot cradle (heel in cradle, toes free). Pull toes toward shin against strap resistance.
nearbySupersets.safety: Tibialis anterior maintenance for gait recovery. Fully seated.

nearbySupersets.title: Dead Hang (Spinal Decompression)
nearbySupersets.instruction: Hang from the bar with both hands, shoulders packed. Let lower body hang fully relaxed — legs are dead weight.
nearbySupersets.safety: Zero leg involvement. Passive hang decompresses spine and stretches lats. Use a box to get up safely.

nearbySupersets.title: Quad Sets (Seated on Bars)
nearbySupersets.instruction: Sit on one of the parallel bars or the dip station seat. Press back of left knee into the bar surface. Hold 5 seconds, release, repeat.
nearbySupersets.safety: Pure isometric, zero joint stress. Seated position is fully NWB-safe.

nearbySupersets.title: Prone Trunk Extension
nearbySupersets.instruction: Stay face-down on the ham curl machine. Hands behind head (add plate to progress). Lift chest 1-2" off pad. Hold 1s at top, lower with control.
nearbySupersets.safety: Same machine, same position. Ankles locked under pad = zero lower-body demand. Full posterior chain superset with ham curls.

nearbySupersets.title: Prone Iso Hold
nearbySupersets.instruction: Stay face-down on the ham curl machine. Lift chest slightly off pad. Hold 20-45 seconds. Breathe into brace — don't hold breath.
nearbySupersets.safety: Isometric erector endurance. Same machine, zero transitions. Breathe through the hold.

nearbySupersets.title: Prone Y-Raise
nearbySupersets.instruction: Stay face-down on the ham curl machine. Arms hang down, thumbs up. Lift arms into Y overhead at ~45°. Squeeze lower traps 2s at top.
nearbySupersets.safety: Pure scapular work. Zero lower-body demand. Excellent shoulder health between ham curl sets.

nearbySupersets.title: Prone T-Raise
nearbySupersets.instruction: Stay face-down on the ham curl machine. Raise arms straight out to sides, palms down. Pinch shoulder blades together. Hold 1-2s.
nearbySupersets.safety: Mid-trap retraction. Same machine, zero transitions. Counterbalances pressing volume.

nearbySupersets.title: Prone W-Raise
nearbySupersets.instruction: Stay face-down on the ham curl machine. Elbows bent 90°, externally rotate. Squeeze shoulder blades down & back into W. Hold 2s.
nearbySupersets.safety: Rotator cuff prehab. Same machine, zero transitions. Critical for shoulder health.

nearbySupersets.title: Prone Lateral Trunk Raise
nearbySupersets.instruction: Stay face-down on the ham curl machine. Small side bend — lift & rotate torso slightly left/right. Alternate sides each rep.
nearbySupersets.safety: Obliques and QL in a NWB-safe prone position. Keep range small and controlled.

mobilitySupplement.name: Seated Cat-Cow
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Sit upright on the machine seat or bench. Inhale: arch back, lift chest, look up (cow). Exhale: round upper back, tuck chin (cat). Move slowly through each breath.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Pure spinal ROM. Zero leg involvement. Can be done on any seated machine between sets.

mobilitySupplement.name: Seated Thoracic Rotations
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Sit upright, arms crossed over chest. Rotate torso left and right, keeping hips square. Hold each end-range for a second.
mobilitySupplement.safety: T-spine mobility reset between pressing/pulling sets. Hips don't move — rotation is pure thoracic.

mobilitySupplement.name: Gentle Neck Rolls
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Drop chin to chest. Slowly roll head ear-to-shoulder, back, and around. Small range — no neck cranking.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Gentle ROM. Great after heavy pressing or pulling. Stop if any pinching.

mobilitySupplement.name: Seated Pec Opener
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Sit tall. Clasp hands behind lower back. Lift chest and pull shoulders back and down. Breathe into the stretch.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Opens the anterior chest after pressing volume. Stop if shoulders pinch — don't force range.

mobilitySupplement.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Reach right arm overhead, drop hand behind neck toward opposite shoulder blade. Pull elbow gently with left hand. Switch sides.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Perfect between pressing sets. Keep ribs down so you don't arch lower back.

mobilitySupplement.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Pull right arm across chest with left hand cradling the elbow. Hold, then switch.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Posterior capsule and rear delt stretch. Great after pushing or pulling volume.

mobilitySupplement.name: Seated Lat Side-Bend
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Sit tall. Raise right arm overhead, reach up and side-bend to the left. Feel the stretch along the right lat. Switch sides.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Opens the lats between pulling sets. Hips stay planted — only the torso bends.

mobilitySupplement.name: Rhomboid Self-Hug
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Wrap arms around self (self-hug). Round upper back and reach hands toward opposite shoulder blades. Let upper back spread.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Upper back and rhomboid stretch. Good reset between rowing sets.

mobilitySupplement.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Extend right arm, palm up. Gently pull fingers back toward you with left hand. Feel stretch in forearm. Switch.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Grip and wrist reset between heavy compound sets.

mobilitySupplement.name: Wrist Circles
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Clasp hands together, rotate wrists in slow circles — clockwise then counter-clockwise.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Wrist ROM for pressing and pulling days. Zero load.

mobilitySupplement.name: Right Hamstring Reach
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Sit tall, extend right leg out in front (heel on floor). Hinge from hips and reach toward right toes. Left leg stays passive — hanging or supported.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Right side only. NO left-leg stretch (fracture side stays passive).

mobilitySupplement.name: Right Calf Towel Stretch
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Sit with right leg extended. Loop a towel (or hands) around right forefoot. Gently pull toes toward you. Hold.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Right calf only — gait prep. Left leg stays passive throughout.

mobilitySupplement.name: Right Hip Flexor Reset
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Sit on edge of bench. Slide right foot slightly behind the knee line. Tuck pelvis under (posterior tilt) and feel the front of the right hip open. Release and repeat.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Right side ONLY. Left hip stays neutral. Do not stretch the left hip flexor.

mobilitySupplement.name: Box Breathing
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Inhale 4 counts, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4. Repeat 4 rounds.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Parasympathetic reset between heavy working sets. Lowers HR and sharpens focus.

mobilitySupplement.name: Crocodile Breath (Seated)
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Sit tall. Hands on lower ribs. Inhale slowly through the nose — feel ribs expand outward into your hands. Exhale fully through pursed lips.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Diaphragmatic activation. Great between pressing sets to reset bracing pattern.

mobilitySupplement.name: Scapular Packing Hold
mobilitySupplement.instruction: Sit upright. Pull shoulder blades down and together (back pocket cue). Hold 10 seconds, release, repeat.
mobilitySupplement.safety: Scap positioning reset — great before pressing or pulling. Pure isometric.

cableSuperset.title: Left Ankle Dorsiflexion
cableSuperset.instruction: Low cable, strap around top of left foot. Pull toes toward shin against cable resistance.
cableSuperset.safety: Tibialis anterior maintenance for gait recovery. Fully seated or reclined.

genericSeatedSuperset.title: Quad Sets
genericSeatedSuperset.instruction: Press back of left knee into seat surface. Hold 5 seconds, release, repeat.
genericSeatedSuperset.safety: Pure isometric, zero joint stress. Can be done between any seated exercise.
